title: Faculty Director, Doctor of Education Leadership Program Senior Lecturer on Education
bio: Frank Barnes is faculty director of the Doctor of Education Leadership Program. He has over 30 years experience as an educator, researcher, and organizer. As a chief accountability officer, he led turnaround efforts for large public school districts, including Boston Public Schools and Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
